widowNote: ELEVEN CARDS EACH AND A THREE-CARD WIDOW. The widow is credited to the declarer at the end, except at either misere.
calledNote: At a call solo, whoever holds the named card must exchange it.
spreadNote: A spread misere lays the declarer's hand face up.
bidNotice: Choose a bid. Only a higher bid stands.
baseTargetNote: A PLAIN BID NEEDS MORE THAN 60 — 61 points, not 60 (there are {{total}} card points in play).
misereNote: A MISERE ASKS FOR ZERO CARD POINTS, not zero tricks. A trick of nines and lower is harmless.
callNotice: This is a call solo, so also name the card you want exchanged.
playNotice: Following suit is compulsory. Only playable cards can be chosen.

tutorial.info: The hand number, the contract and the target appear here.
tutorial.players: Each seat's card points, tricks and running total. The three widow cards stay face down until the settlement.
tutorial.hand: Your hand of eleven. Following suit is compulsory, so cards you cannot play are disabled.
tutorial.actions: Pick one of the six bids. A plain bid needs 61 points; a misere needs zero card points.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.
